narr: A slow moving surface to mid level low pressure system developed over the Coastal Bend of south Texas on July 6th. This was the start of a multi-day heavy rain event across the Coastal Bend as the low pressure system remained nearly stationary through the 8th of July. Locally heavy rainfall caused flooding Rockport and Flour Bluff on the 6th.
ev: Spectrum News Media reported flooding along Grand Canal Drive and Glen Oak Drive between Flour Bluff Drive and St. Peter Street in Flour Bluff. Flooding also occurred at the |intersection of Ennis Joslin Drive and South Padre Island Drive in Corpus Christi.
Frontage road on Highway 181 on the southeast side of Beeville was closed due to being covered by high water. Video also showed creek overflowing a bridge southeast of Beeville.
Social media reported street flooding occurred throughout the city of Rockport.
lsr: SOCIAL MEDIA REPORT OF STREET FLOODING THROUGHOUT ROCKPORT.
SPECTRUM NEWS REPORTED FLOODING ALONG GRAND CANAL DRIVE IN FLOWER BLUFF.
